source_text: South Africa's Eastern Cape province has seen recurrent fatalities; for instance, 14 boys died from botched circumcisions in a single month in 2006, while over 20 deaths occurred during the 2019 winter season alone, prompting temporary suspensions of initiation schools. [54] [55]
